blocks.text: As more Filipinos take a longer-term view of their health and financial well-being, protection solutions that can support them through life’s uncertainties continue to play an important role. For Sun Life Philippines, this enduring need is reflected in SUN Fit and Well, its comprehensive health protection and life insurance plan, which continues to help Clients prepare for health-related challenges 10 years after its launch. As of June 2026, more than 230,000 SUN Fit and Well policies have been sold, with over PHP 600 million in claims paid to Clients and their families.
